description: This PHP file defines the Authorize controller within the Opencart e-commerce platform. It contains methods to send authorization emails to customers and reset authorization tokens, utilizing models for customer data and task scheduling, and rendering email templates.

classes.name: Authorize
classes.description: Controller class handling authorization email sending and reset functionalities in the Opencart platform.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles sending authorization email to the logged-in customer if a session code exists. Loads customer data, prepares email content, and schedules email sending task.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Handles sending reset authorization emails to specific customers based on provided arguments, including constructing reset URL and scheduling email task.
